newsitem.title: USA: U.S. urges Kabila to form broad Zaire government.
newsitem.headline: U.S. urges Kabila to form broad Zaire government.

text.p: The United States has urged rebel leader Laurent Kabila to form an "inclusive" government after his victory in Zaire's civil war, President Clinton's national security adviser said on Sunday.

"We have urged him to respect human rights," the adviser, Samuel Berger, said in an interview on CNN. "We have urged him to form a government that is inclusive, and ultimately, to move toward democracy."
"And we're going to continue to work with him toward that objective," he added.

Kabila, 56, declared himself head of state on Saturday as his forces moved into Kinshasa virtually unopposed. Ousted President Mobutu Sese Seko was reported to have fled to a jungle palace in the northern village of Gbadolite.
